code_vuln:
from __future__ import absolute_import
import os
import logging
import ssl
from pathlib import Path
import platform


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Otherwise it will complain SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED
# When trying to download models from torchvision
ssl._create_default_https_context = ssl._create_unverified_context

TRITON_MODEL_DIR = os.getenv("TRITON_MODEL_DIR")
explanation: The vulnerable module globally monkey-patches ssl._create_default_https_context to ssl._create_unverified_context, disabling TLS certificate verification process-wide in the Triton model server. This enables MITM interception and tampering of HTTPS model/dependency downloads, matching CWE-295 / CRYPTO-010 exactly. The fix removes the override entirely, restoring default certificate verification. The advisory (GHSA-62rc-f4v9-h543 / CVE-2026-1778) describes this precise issue, and the code pair cleanly demonstrates the defect and its correction.
finding: Global monkey-patch of ssl._create_default_https_context to ssl._create_unverified_context disables TLS certificate verification process-wide, enabling MITM attacks on HTTPS traffic.
